events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: William John Paul Gallagher, known as Liam Gallagher, was born on September 21, 1972, and rose to fame as the lead singer of Oasis.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Icon
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! The voice of a generation, still bringing the swagger. What's your favourite Oasis track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' (UK Single, 1975)
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 24, 1975, four years after its initial album release.

angles.name: A Song For Peace
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' single hit the UK. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: The First iPod Unveiled (2001)
events.blurb: On October 23, 2001, Apple unveiled the first iPod, revolutionising portable music with '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember life before streaming? 25 years ago this month, Apple gave us the first iPod, putting a thousand songs in our pocket. A game-changer!

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the 1962 premiere of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, of course) to over six decades of 007. What's your favourite Bond film?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Today, we remember John Lennon, who would have been 86. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your most cherished Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Royalty
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: A Classic Turns 58
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed their iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that pushed boundaries. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's Death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Forever a Champion
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul,' in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Fab Four's Folk-Rock Masterpiece
angles.copy: On this day 61 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them evolve into new sonic territory. Pure genius.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's Death
events.blurb: John Lennon, the legendary musician and peace activist, was tragically killed on December 8, 1980, in New York City.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a visionary. John Lennon's legacy of music and peace lives on. Share your favourite memory of his work.
